name: Dark Phoenix

abilityDetails.Safeguard: Vurulurken veya bloklarken herhangi bir kaynaktan alınabilecek can kaybını belirli bir yüzdeyle sınırlar.
abilityDetails.Nova Flame: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Pulverize: Bir Armor Up etkisini kaldırır ve doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Nova alevi (sadece Iceman ve kendisi immün), ölümsüzlük, koruma ve kök salan özel saldırıları var. Zehir uygulamak (Mystic ise) nova alevi süresini tamamen sıfırlayabilir — bu en önemli tehlikeyi giderir. Fate-seal, bonus immünitesi ve zayıflatma (Mojo, Kindred, Absorbing Man, Shathra, The Hood, Claire) korumasını/ölümsüzlüğünü engeller. Yüksek enerji direnci (en az %60) avantaj sağlar. Isophyne, Spiral ve Absorbing Man ölümsüzlüğü tamamen önleyebilir.
signatureAbility:
Ease Into Darkness
As a Defender, gain a Phoenix Rising Charge at 5+ Ember Charges.
At the start of each fight, lower the Health threshold on Safeguard by [8 - 60]%.
While Immortal, Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
immunityDetails:

• Güç Emme Bağışıklığı 🔋

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Dark Phoenix's phenomenal cosmic power grants her Immunity to Incinerate, Nova Flame, and Power Drain.
Dark Phoenix's Ability and Combat Power Rates cannot be reduced by more than 50%.
If any of Dark Phoenix's personal Buffs fail due to Ability Accuracy reduction or are removed due to Stagger or Nullify, they re-trigger as a Passive.

abilitySections.title: A Phoenix's Flame - Ember Charges - Max: 15
content: Ember Charges are indefinite and increase the potency of Dark Phoenix's Nova Flame by 20% per Charge.
+1 Charge when landing a second Medium Attack or when Dark Phoenix's Safeguard prevents damage.
-1 Charge when Dark Phoenix is knocked down by a Special Attack.
+5 Ember Charges at the start of each fight as a Defender.

abilitySections.title: Life-Force Control - Safeguard
content: At the start of each fight, Dark Phoenix gains a 5% Safeguard Buff for 10.5 seconds. The damage threshold of this effect is 20% lower when Phoenix has Class Advantage, 40% higher when she has Class Disadvantage, and its potency cannot be otherwise modified.
This Safeguard is removed when the Opponent activates a Special Attack 3, and, as an Attacker, after reducing damage. This Buff re-activates every 10 seconds.
At 5+ Ember Charges, Safeguard also reduces the potency of incoming Damaging effects and Power Stings from Champions by 75%.

abilitySections.title: A Phoenix Rising - Nova Flame - Max: 3
content: Upon reaching 10+ Ember Charges for the first time each fight, Dark Phoenix gains a Phoenix Rising Charge.
This Charge is consumed when Dark Phoenix would be Knocked Out, granting an Immortality Buff for 12 seconds.

Upon consumption, the Opponent is inflicted with a [11,244] Nova Flame Passive for 20 seconds, reducing Block Proficiency by 60%. As a Defender this scales with Base Attack only. If suffering from Poison when activated, the duration is reduced by 20% per Poison. Max reduction from Poison inflicted by non-Mystics: 40%.
Dark Phoenix passively Regenerates Health equal to 100% of the Energy Damage caused while Immortal.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Pulverize 2 Armor Up effects if any are active, dealing a burst of [2,811] Direct Damage per Armor Up removed.
Removing an Armor Up this way grants 1 Ember Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Upon finishing her Special Attacks, Dark Phoenix continues siphoning energy from the Phoenix Force over 3 seconds. Upon expiry, she inflicts the Opponent with her personal Nova Flame.
Striking her during this time disrupts her channeling, reducing the duration of this Nova Flame by 13% per hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain an Unstoppable Buff for 5 seconds. As an Attacker, the duration is decreased by 5% per Ember Charge, excluding permanent ones.
On activation, gain 3 Ember Charges. Then, if at 5+ Ember Charges, gain a Power Gain Buff granting 15% of Max Power over 5 seconds. Max stacks: 2. As an Attacker, this gains +10% flat potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, Dark Phoenix's telekinetic powers inflict a Root Passive until after the last hit.
On activation, gain a non-stacking +[3,373.2] Fury Buff for 35 seconds. This Fury gains +30% flat potency per Ember Charge.
As an Attacker, at the end of this attack consume half of all Ember Charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain +3 permanent Ember Charges which cannot be removed. Max stacks: 9.
Inflict an indefinite Nova Flame Passive, dealing [281.1] Energy Damage per second. As a Defender, this scales with Base Attack only. Max stacks: 3.
Gain a non-stacking Power Gain Buff, granting 100% of Max Power over 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Ease Into Darkness
content: As a Defender, gain a Phoenix Rising Charge at 5+ Ember Charges.
At the start of each fight, lower the Health threshold on Safeguard by [8 - 60]%.
While Immortal, Special Attacks are Passively Unblockable.
